reserveReview.rationale: Issuer factsheet dated September 30, 2026 reports commercial paper 40.5%, certificates of deposit 28.9%, time deposits 23.3% and cash 7.4% of total net assets, totalling 100.1% as published; that rounding noise sits inside the approved 0.5-point composition tolerance and is reconciled mechanically, never hand-normalized. It reports 32 positions, USD 26m whole-fund size, WAM 41 days and WAL 73 days, and a Class 1 ACC NAV of 101.36. These averages are not maximum tenor. The exact Class 1 ACC identity is FILQ-A, ISIN KYG3R61G1088; Class 1 DIST is a separate claim. The Moody's Aaa-mf fund assessment is explicitly not a credit rating. The same issuer factsheet endpoint now serves the September 30, 2026 edition (published 2026-10-26T07:32Z), superseding the August 31 edition reviewed on 2026-10-09. Direct PDF access returned 403; the issuer document was recovered through its text mirror on 2026-10-29. The whole-fund asset-class percentages are not a token-level FILQ-A asset/liability reconciliation and do not prove 1:1 backing; the September 30 portfolio date, not the mirror's HTTP timestamp or this review date, governs freshness.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Published September 30, 2026 whole-fund asset-class percentages of total net assets
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Security-level counterparties and a complete Class 1 ACC token-to-fund asset/liability reconciliation remain unavailable. September 30 whole-fund size is not FILQ-A current token liabilities. Named custodians and auditors do not prove account-level custody allocation or financial assurance. No current backing, Exit capacity or 1:1 token claim is inferred beyond the published whole-fund composition.
